mentions.name: ShopSpec
mentions.description: ShopSpec is a parametric, deterministic furniture builder for designing furniture pieces. It includes a gallery of actual builds, with more projects in progress while the tool continues to be built out and iterated on.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still working on ShopSpec, a parametric deterministic furniture builder. Trying to find time to put more actual builds in the gallery - have a few projects that are in progress while continuing to build out the tool and iterate where I find personally useful.

https://shopspec.io
